description: Minimal LinkedIn workflow for Chief OS v1: read-only job/discovery signal intake, profile/post/outreach DRAFT generation, dedupe against Career Ops + Company Watch, and handoff into the existing Career Ops tracker writer. LinkedIn is treated strictly as a READ-ONLY signal source and a DRAFT surface. Nothing in this workflow posts, messages, connects, follows, reacts, applies or mutates any account, and nothing here opens a network connection or a browser.
external_action_policy: External LinkedIn posting, messaging, connection requests, reactions, follows, profile edits and application submission are OWNER-GATED. This workflow refuses them and records the refusal; it implements no path that performs them.
not_performed: Any LinkedIn login, session use, API call or scraping
Any browser launch or GUI interaction
Any posting, messaging, connection request, reaction or profile mutation
Any application submission or employer/recruiter contact
